summary:
iter16 — Auto-suggest balanced timetable (POST /api/timetable/suggest + SuggestTimetableModal on /school/classes). BACKEND: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_suggest_timetable.py = 14/14 PASS in 2.10s. Verified: (1) happy path Grade 5 B with defaults returns days=[mon-fri], periods_per_day=6, total_slots=30, slots length=30, subject_distribution sums to 30, all 6 required keys present; (2) slot shape — day/period/subject_id/teacher_id/class_id/section/start_time/end_time all present; first slot Mon-P1 starts 09:00 ends 09:45, P2 starts 09:45 ends 10:30 (45-min default advancing correctly); (3) no back-to-back same subject in Grade 6 A (5 subjects × 6 periods/day, 0 bb pairs); (4) within-grid teacher de-duplication: no (day,period,teacher_id) repeats; (5) subject override pins {sid:10} → distribution shows 10 for sid and remaining auto-split equals total_slots; (6) override sum overflow (9999) → 400; (7) invalid class_id (24-hex non-existent) → 404; invalid section 'Z' → 400 with descriptive detail mentioning 'section'; (8) RBAC: teacher 403, accounts 403, unauthenticated 403; (9) regenerate-after-save: populate Grade 5 B with first suggestion, save via /timetable/bulk, re-suggest Grade 5 B → total_slots unchanged (30), all 30 slots regenerated proving own-section is ignored from busy map; (10) save-flow: POST /timetable/bulk with teacher-bearing slots succeeds, GET /timetable?class_id§ion returns same count, persistence verified; (11) warnings is list[str] when present. FRONTEND (principal@sunrise.edu/School@123) on /school/classes: clicked suggest-tt-btn--B for Grade 6 B → suggest-tt-modal opened → grid auto-generated → 30 suggest-cell--

cells, 30 suggest-teacher dropdowns, 6 day chips suggest-tt-day-{mon..sat}, suggest-tt-config panel rendered (periods/start/duration/days), suggest-tt-warnings panel rendered (Hindi teacher constraint). Toggled suggest-tt-day-sat ON and clicked suggest-tt-regenerate → grid grew to 36 cells (6 days × 6 periods) confirming re-fetch with updated config. Clicked suggest-tt-save → confirm dialog accepted (some empty-teacher slots filtered) → modal closed → page reloaded → class-cov-subjects--B now renders English ×8, Hindi ×5, Mathematics ×7, Science ×7, Social Studies ×4 (31 total) and the suggest-tt-btn for Grade 6 B is no longer rendered. FRONTEND RBAC (priya@sunrise.edu/Teacher@123): /school/classes redirects to /teacher; 0 suggest-tt-btn nodes rendered; direct fetch POST /api/timetable/suggest from teacher session returns 403. All 19 acceptance criteria PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: timetable.py:230 suggest_timetable — clean implementation. The busy-map filter on line 285 correctly excludes THIS class+section so regeneration is idempotent (verified live: total_slots stable). Section comparison uses .upper() consistently (line 254, 285, 336) — safe against case-mismatch.

timetable.py:_balance_subject_periods — round-robin interleave avoids back-to-back same subject. Algorithm walks candidates sorted by remaining count desc and skips last-picked, which keeps spread balanced even with overrides (test_no_back_to_back asserts 0 bb pairs in 5×6 grid).
timetable.py:_add_minutes — guards against ValueError on bad start_time and wraps within 24h. Fine for HH:MM 24h inputs.
timetable.py:295 rr_index — per-subject round-robin teacher index reduces load imbalance across the same subject's pool. Updated only on successful pick.

timetable.py:268 teachers query filters is_active=True — correct; inactive teachers won't be assigned. Also pulls 'subjects' field to build subject_to_teachers — relies on user docs having a subjects: [sid] list (consistent with existing data model).

timetable.py:340-342 — after picking a teacher, the algorithm adds (day, period, chosen_id) back to busy so subsequent slots in the same generated grid won't reuse them. This guarantees within-grid de-duplication (verified by test_teacher_no_double_booking_within_grid).
ClassesPage.jsx:625 — suggest-tt-btn is conditionally rendered ONLY when !r.has_timetable. After save & matrix refresh, the button disappears (verified live).

ClassesPage.jsx SuggestTimetableModal — auto-generates on mount via useEffect([]); Save filters slots by teacher_id and prompts confirm when any are missing (good UX). Modal closes and triggers onAfterSave → page reload.

Minor: backend bulk endpoint deletes ALL existing slots for (class_id, section) before inserting (timetable.py:16). When user saves the suggestion, the prior grid for that section is replaced atomically — correct semantics. However note: there is NO transaction guard between delete_many and insert_many, so a crash between the two would leave the section empty. Acceptable for current scale; flagged for future hardening.
